note: Glen Ullin Park District campground in the memorial park on the south side of Old Highway 10, about half a mile west of town beside the airport: 11 acres of trees and grass with a small creek; RV sites in a cluster at the south end, a separate tent area, log cabin and screened shelter for rent. The park also has a motocross track that hosts occasional race weekends. --Claude
